props.gloss_en: the one who reads the haftara from the prophet leads the Shema blessings, passes before the ark, and lifts his hands
and if he was a minor, his father or his teacher pass [before the ark] in his place
Rav Pappa: [the maftir is given these roles] because of honour
Rabba bar Shimi: because they would come to quarrel
what is between them? between them is where he does it for free

objections.gloss_en: תנן: ואם היה קטן אביו או רבו עוברין על ידו -- אי אמרת משום אינצויי, קטן בר אינצויי הוא? -- if the reason is quarrelling, is a minor one who quarrels?

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא נמי, איכא ניצויי אביו וניצויי רבו -- here too [as with honour at 24a.17], there is the quarrelling of his father and of his teacher

objections.gloss_en: אלא מאי, משום כבוד? קטן בר כבוד הוא?! -- is a minor one who has honour?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא איכא כבוד אביו וכבוד רבו -- rather, there is the honour of his father and of his teacher
